narrative:
Group GP margin is 22.6% in the plan, +1.4pp on FY2025, with a planned average list-price change of +3%. Margin ranges from 6% on Carrier Wholesale SMS to 68% on the CPaaS Engagement Platform, so channel mix moves margin as much as price does.

Two levers matter. Pass-through: Nordic operators raise termination 5-7% from January, and Enterprise SMS contracts in Norway and Sweden allow indexation. Mix: moving notification traffic to WhatsApp bundles and RCS lifts GP per message even when revenue per message falls.

The Channel Mix Agent recommends a 4% Enterprise SMS pass-through with an international-origin surcharge, bundled WhatsApp packs in Central Europe, and repricing or upselling low-margin campaign deals in Western Europe.

signals.title: Nordic operators announce A2P termination increases
signals.excerpt: Telenor, Telia and Telia Finland notify 5-7% A2P SMS termination increases effective 1 January 2026.

signals.title: Meta moves WhatsApp Business to per-message pricing
signals.excerpt: Utility and authentication templates billed per message from July 2025; marketing templates repriced by market.

signals.title: RCS Business Messaging launches across Nordics
signals.excerpt: Nordic operators open RCS for brands; early retail pilots show 2.4x engagement vs plain SMS.
